page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, operating with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration, and it does not feature complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated CPU allocation and 1:1 physical-to-virtual core ratio ensure consistent compute performance without resource contention. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring predictable CPU execution and a balanced memory-to-core ratio. Suitable workloads include general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, and medium-scale database hosting where local NVMe storage is not a prerequisite.
